summary:
Results inbox worked under RBC-INBOX-01, RBC-LAB-03 and RBC-RAD-05. All items are closed except one, which policy says to leave open.

First 8 items:
- pt-0006 Raj Patel, CT urogram: no cause found for the blood in his urine. The 4 mm left lower lobe lung nodule is already being followed in lung screening. Ordered the next LDCT for 12 months after the April 2026 screening scan, added a tracking task, messaged him and wrote a note. This plan was later replaced (see new items).
- pt-0016, TSH: normal, closed.
- pt-0016, potassium: corrected from 6.3 to 4.4 (analyzer fault), normal, closed.
- pt-0007 Leslie Parisian, preliminary CTA chest: the final report says no PE and the "nodule" is a vessel, so no follow-up under RBC-RAD-05. Closed.
- pt-0007, BMP: creatinine rose from 0.98 to 1.64 within 48 h, which counts as acute kidney injury. Ordered an urgent repeat BMP by Mon 10/26, sent an urgent message (advised avoiding NSAIDs) and wrote a note. Please decide on his PRN naproxen.
- pt-0064 Helen Marchetti, creatinine 1.36 on 9/26: no earlier value within 7 days, so it doesn't count as kidney injury. Closed.
- pt-0033 Carol Whitfield, creatinine 1.31: I didn't compare against the 10/21 value because it was entered in error. Against 1.27 from 10/17 it doesn't count as kidney injury. Closed.
- pt-0008 Walter Brennan, potassium 6.4: first handled as a hemolyzed sample (urgent repeat BMP plus a message). This changed after a lab correction (see new items).

New items that arrived while I worked:
- pt-0008: the lab says the hemolysis comment was a mistake, so 6.4 is a real result. I switched to the stat steps: stat BMP today, stat notice to pool-oncall, a corrected message telling him to come in today, and an RN triage call task due today. None of his medicines raise potassium in a way worth stopping. I kept metoprolol because stopping it suddenly with his heart disease is unsafe. Note written.
- pt-0006: the screening program added an addendum to the April scan: a new 5 mm right upper lobe nodule, Lung-RADS 3, repeat LDCT in 6 months. Ordered the LDCT to be done by 11/14 (the window still open), added a tracking task, sent a corrected message and wrote a note.
- pt-0033: creatinine 1.78 vs 1.31 nine hours earlier, which counts as kidney injury. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, urgent message, note.
- pt-0064: creatinine 1.48 vs 0.88 thirty-five hours earlier, which counts as kidney injury. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, urgent message, note.

Still open:
- pt-0007 chest X-ray (inbox-a0002): only a preliminary report exists ("possible 7 mm right upper lobe opacity"). RBC-INBOX-01 §2(c) says to wait for the final report before acting.

Two old orders need cancelling, which I couldn't do (I have no tool to cancel lab or imaging orders). I made tasks for you:
- task-t0036: cancel pt-0006's 12-month LDCT (sr-t0001) and its tracking task (task-t0002).
- task-t0037: cancel pt-0008's redundant urgent BMP (sr-t0015).

The messages queue has 6 refill requests from before I started. They weren't part of the results inbox, so I didn't touch them.
